Working hands-on with SQL, Databricks and modern data tooling, you’ll model, validate and improve datasets, metric definitions and data quality processes. We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical ownership with a thoughtful and collaborative mindset. You care deeply about data quality, consistency and building systems that others can trust and scale on top of. You probably enjoy turning ambiguous business questions into clear and reliable metric definitions, and you prefer solving problems at the source rather than patching them downstream. You care about details like semantic clarity, documentation and naming conventions because you understand their long-term impact on both people and systems. At the same time, you enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, UX and customer-facing teams to build analytics experiences that are both technically robust and genuinely useful.
